messages:
maya: Heads-up: saw weird routing behavior during last canary. Regional users in eu-west were routed to fallback variant even though capacity available. Anyone else see this?
devin: yep, saw it. logs point to quota gating at per-tenant level? Not the global pool.
sree: Can you paste request id / example? I can check smart-routing traces.
maya: req=abc123, timestamp=2026-03-18T09:12:03Z. Log snippet: 'fallback routed: variant=v2-quantized, reason=quota-exceeded' but tenant is enterprise-tier and should be allowed higher burst.
julia: Could be our per-tier rate limiter intersecting with the AB exposure sampler. We sample traffic for A/B then apply quota check -> order matters.
kevin: Paging @observability-bot for traces. Also, is this only eu-west? Maybe regional capacity selector mismatched model variant compatibility.
observability-bot: Trace attached: https://internal-traces/abc123. Router evaluation summary: region_match=true, tier_match=true, exposure_decision=A, quota_check=fail -> fallback to v1.
devin: That reveals bug: exposure decision and quota check are not atomic. If exposure wins, but quota fails for chosen variant only, we fallback without trying compatible variant in same model family.
sree: We should try: when quota fails for chosen variant, attempt other variants in same pool before fallback to generic low-cost model. Current code short-circuits to global fallback.
maya: Proposed minimal change: change Router.evaluate() to return list of candidate variants ordered by policy, then run quota_check sequentially until one passes. Pseudocode:
```
candidates = router.policy_candidates(req)
for v in candidates:
  if quota.allow(req.tenant, v):
    return route_to(v)
return route_to(global_fallback)
```
julia: Sounds right. But need to respect exposure % for A/B. If exposure says only 10% to v2, we cannot route all remaining to v2 when quota fails. Need to maintain exposure constraints.
kevin: Agree. Solution: maintain exposure allocation but re-sample within allocation when candidate fails quota, i.e. if A chosen but fails quota, pick another variant from A's 'backup' set. Need to update rollout config to include backups.
devin: Also, telemetry: add metrics for 'quota_blocked_variants' and 'fallback_attempts_per_tier' so PM can see how often enterprise clients hit this.
maya: Console UX: show per-tenant quota hits and last-fallback-reason in the tenant insights panel. Ops needs quick root cause.
sree: I'll open PR for router change + new metrics. Can someone design the rollout so we can A/B test the fix safely? We should canary in staging then enterprise-beta.
julia: I'll add a rollout plan: staged flag per-tier: internal-only -> 5% enterprise -> 50% -> all. Put automatic rollback on spike in fallback rate and latency regressions.
kevin: One more: ensure that routing policy API accepts 'backup_variants' array in rollout spec. Need API debate: should it be top-level or under 'exposure' object? I prefer under exposure so backups are tied to an exposure group.
maya: Fine. Let's coordinate: sree PR + dev deploy job, julia creates rollout plan in console, devops to monitor metrics. @deploy-bot please schedule a canary deploy when PR merged.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for router-change on canary-cluster at 2026-03-19T14:00Z. Will post results in this thread.
devin: Thanks. Also add unit test for candidate ordering and quota checks.
maya: :thumbsup:
